name: Villanueva de Carazo (Spain)
description: Square flag divided vertically red and white in the proportions 1:2, the white charged with the crowned municipal arms of Villanueva de Carazo (a castle on red and a mountain on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Villanueva de Carazo; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Villanueva de Carazo arms — castle and mountain
